restaurant.heroSubtitle: The freshest flavors of the Aegean, organic ingredients, and local recipes
restaurant.cuisineDescription: In our Palma Alacati kitchen, we combine the rich gastronomic heritage of the Aegean with modern presentations. Our dishes, prepared with fresh herbs from our garden, cheeses and olive oils from local producers, offer the taste of Alaçatı in every bite.
restaurant.breakfastDesc: A rich Aegean breakfast freshly prepared every morning. Village cheeses, olive oil, fresh bread, jam varieties, and seasonal fruits.
restaurant.lunchDesc: Light Mediterranean flavors, fresh salads, olive oil dishes, and seafood. Served by the pool or on the restaurant terrace.
restaurant.dinnerDesc: A special menu carefully prepared by our chef. Seasonal flavors made with the finest Aegean ingredients. Reservation recommended.
restaurant.organicGardenDesc: Some of the herbs and vegetables used in our restaurant are harvested from our own organic garden.
restaurant.localProducerDesc: Our cheeses, olive oils, and charcuterie products are sourced from local producers in and around Alaçatı.
restaurant.wineMenuDesc: Carefully selected wines from premium Aegean vineyards, ready to complement your meals.
restaurant.specialEventDesc: Custom menus and decorations can be prepared for birthdays, anniversaries, or special evenings.
restaurant.reservationDesc: We recommend making a reservation in advance for dinner.

aboutPage.storyDesc1: Palma Alacati was established in 2022 as a boutique apart hotel in the Hacımemiş Neighborhood of Alaçatı. Our goal was to combine the unique Aegean lifestyle with modern comfort and personalized service.
aboutPage.storyDesc2: Today, with our 5 uniquely designed apartments, lush garden, and seasonal outdoor pool, we continue to create unforgettable moments for our guests. Each apartment stands out with its unique interior design and private kitchen.
aboutPage.quoteText: Every guest is a part of our family.
aboutPage.year2022Desc: Palma Alacati was established as a boutique apart hotel in Hacımemiş Neighborhood.
aboutPage.year2023Desc: New apartments were added, and the seasonal outdoor pool opened.
aboutPage.year2024Desc: Premium experiences began with Aegean Suite and Deluxe Apart Duplex concepts.
aboutPage.year2025Desc: Recognized as one of the most exclusive addresses in Alaçatı with a 4.9 Google rating.
aboutPage.hospitalityDesc: We see every guest as part of our family, offering a warm and sincere welcome.
aboutPage.sustainabilityDesc: With our principle of respect for nature, we use organic materials and renewable energy.
aboutPage.authenticityDesc: We create an authentic experience by preserving the historical and cultural fabric of Alaçatı.
aboutPage.excellenceDesc: We aim for the highest quality in every detail, continuously improving ourselves.

data.hotelDescription: A boutique apart hotel experience in the Hacımemiş Neighborhood of Alaçatı, with 5 uniquely designed apartments. Each apartment provides the serenity of the Aegean with its unique interior design, private kitchen, and garden view.
data.roomAegeanDesc: Inspired by Aegean breezes, the Aegean Suite offers a comfortable living space with a spacious lounge, private kitchen, and elegant bathroom. Adorned with natural stone walls and modern furniture, this suite embodies the authentic atmosphere of Alaçatı in every detail.
data.roomAegeanShort: Spacious lounge, private kitchen, Aegean-inspired design
data.roomDeluxeDesc: With its two-story design, the Deluxe Apart Duplex offers a spacious living area, private kitchen, terrace, and shared pool access. With a bedroom upstairs and living area and kitchen downstairs, this apartment is ideal for extended stays.
data.roomDeluxeShort: Two-story, terrace, private kitchen, pool access
data.roomDesignDesc: With its modern and extraordinary interior design, the Design Apartment is a specially designed accommodation for art-loving guests. It offers a unique Alaçatı experience with quality bedding, private kitchen, and carefully selected decoration details.
data.roomDesignShort: Modern design, quality bedding, private kitchen
data.roomAcquaDesc: Inspired by the water theme, Acqua is designed for those seeking relaxation with its peaceful and airy atmosphere. With its minimalist and elegant decor, private kitchen, and comfortable bed, you'll feel right at home in Alaçatı.
data.roomCurvaDesc: With its soft lines and warm color palette, Curva offers a romantic and inviting atmosphere. With its uniquely designed interior, comfortable bed, and kitchen facilities, it's an ideal Alaçatı retreat for couples.
data.roomCurvaShort: Warm tones, romantic atmosphere, unique design

faq.q1: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a1: Check-in time is 3:00 PM and check-out time is 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out requests are offered free of charge based on availability.
faq.q2: How far is the hotel from the airport?
faq.a2: We are approximately 80 km from İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport.
faq.a3: Unfortunately, pets are not accepted at our property.
faq.a4: Yes, all our apartments have private kitchens including a refrigerator, pots, plates, and kitchen utensils.
faq.a5: Our seasonal outdoor pool is open from May to October.
faq.a6: Yes, there is free open parking approximately 10 meters from the property.
faq.a7: You must be at least 15 years old to check in. Children under 6 are not accepted.
faq.q8: What languages do you provide service in?
faq.a8: Our staff speaks Turkish, English, and Italian.
faq.q9: How far is it to the beach?
faq.a9: The nearest beach is approximately 4 km away. There is a public sandy beach.
